name: 10282 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10282 (New York) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 9 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10282 (New York) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10282 (New York) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10282 (New York) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
